title: The assistant's model bill went up 9x overnight
scenario: The day after a prompt change that enabled long product comparisons, Kestrel's model spend jumped from $410 to $3,710 and comparison questions fail after a long wait. Marketing blames its holiday email. Use the provider usage export and gateway logs to find the cost multiplier and fix the gateway.
task: Group the usage export by request and explain the per-question multiplier
Explain why only comparison questions fail and rule out the traffic increase
Fix the gateway: timeout sized to max_tokens, retry only transient errors with backoff, shared attempt cap, cost cap
Log every attempt with tokens and cost, including discarded ones
acceptance: A long answer is billed once; 400 is never retried
429 honours retry-after, 529 backs off; at most 3 calls per question
Timeouts go to the fallback once; the cost cap raises BudgetExceeded
Root cause named with numbers from the evidence

practices.label: Week 3 - rate limits, retries, timeouts and model fallback
Week 3 - cost and latency budgets, tokens per call
Week 5 - resilience patterns: retry budgets and circuit breakers
